authority: One host lease authority per whole fake device, independent of N1D mount publication

host.command: cargo test -p sunlight-fs -p sunlight-ipc -p sunlight-vfs-server --lib --target x86_64-unknown-linux-gnu --offline

evidence.drain: New reads and writes rejected at quiesce. Accepted work settled before barrier admission.
evidence.durability: Visible fake writes precede durable writes. Commit gated on matching confirmed barrier.
evidence.failure: Definite normal flush failure restores the incumbent generation. Cancellation waits for a submitted flush to settle. Ambiguous outcomes and transport loss fence acquisition and commit.
evidence.stale_completion: Consumed and foreign tokens cannot change media, credits, or a new generation.
evidence.concurrency: Barrier-driven acquisition, transfer reservation, and transfer commit races each have one winner.
evidence.retirement: Admission closes immediately. Confirmed old operations settle. Durable completion reclaims the device. Definite barrier failure keeps retirement closed for retry.

service.command: RUSTFLAGS='-C link-arg=-Tservices/user-space.ld -C relocation-model=static -C target-cpu=x86-64-v2 -C no-redzone' cargo build --release -p sunlight-vfs-server --offline
